LanguageData.MJV_ArrestRefused: {PAWN_nameDef}'s Promachos helmet will not let {PAWN_objective} be taken: Justiciar Valor!
LanguageData.MJV_PromachosArmorTip: Psychic shield: absorbs gunfire, projectiles, blasts and blows struck in melee. Its strength follows the wearer's psychic sensitivity ({0}): {1} energy for every 100%. It recharges a few seconds after the last hit, and resets some time after it breaks.\n\nInvictus: every hit the shield absorbs stores energy for the Invictus ability. The stored energy fades once the wearer has gone {2} seconds without taking damage.
LanguageData.MJV_InvictusNoArmor: Needs a Promachos armor's psychic shield
LanguageData.MJV_InvictusNotCharged: Not enough stored energy ({0}, needs {1}). The psychic shield stores energy from the hits it absorbs.
LanguageData.MJV_PsyOrbToggleDesc: While switched on, the energy psy-spear synthesizes psy-orbs (one every five seconds, up to three) and keeps them inside. When the wielder is drafted or fighting, the orbs come out to circle the wielder and are launched at enemies within range on their own. Each orb sears what it hits and slows it for a few seconds.\n\nOrbs ready: {0} / {1}
LanguageData.MJV_WarlockbaneTip: Warlockbane: turns aside hostile psychic attacks on the bearer (psycasts, psychic lances, psychic pulses) and stuns their caster with the backlash. Each deflection spends a charge; charges come back slowly.\n\nCharges: {0} / {1}
LanguageData.MJV_TomeNoBlueprints: No unfinished project needs imperial techprints
LanguageData.MJV_TomeNothingToLearn: {PAWN_nameDef} analyzed the imperial codex-auspex but found nothing the colony still needs.
LanguageData.MJV_TomeStudiedText: {PAWN_nameDef} has decoded the data lattices of an imperial codex-auspex and recovered a blueprint for {1}.\n\nTechprints applied: {2} / {3}
LanguageData.MJV_SermonStarted: {PREACHER_nameDef} has begun a sermon of {FAITH}. The colonists called to it gather to listen.
LanguageData.MJV_SermonCancelled: {PREACHER_nameDef}'s sermon was cancelled. {PREACHER_nameDef} takes it as a refusal.
LanguageData.MJV_LordReportAwaitingAnswer: Waiting for the colony to assemble for a sermon.
LanguageData.MJV_SermonNoDrafting: {PAWN_nameDef} is attending {PREACHER_nameDef}'s sermon and cannot be drafted while the colony is safe.
LanguageData.MJV_CommandLeaveSermonDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} leaves the sermon. If fewer than {REQUIRED} listeners remain (now {LISTENING}), the sermon is cancelled, which counts as a refusal.
LanguageData.MJV_CommandCancelSermonDesc: Call off {PREACHER_nameDef}'s sermon. {PREACHER_nameDef} will take it as a refusal: -{PENALTY} goodwill with the Empire when {PREACHER_pronoun} returns.
LanguageData.MJV_ConfirmCancelSermon: Cancel {PREACHER_nameDef}'s sermon?\n\n{PREACHER_nameDef} will take it as a refusal, and it will cost you {PENALTY} goodwill with the Empire when {PREACHER_pronoun} returns.
LanguageData.MJV_SermonRequestedText:
{JUSTICIAR_nameDef} asks your colony to assemble for a sermon of {FAITH}.

Select {JUSTICIAR_nameDef} and choose "Hold sermon" to call your colonists: at least {REQUIRED} of your {ELIGIBLE} conscious colonists must attend. Every colonist beyond that pleases {JUSTICIAR_objective}: a sermon the whole colony hears earns {BONUS} goodwill with the Empire when {JUSTICIAR_pronoun} returns.

You may refuse, but {JUSTICIAR_nameDef} will take offense, and it will cost you {PENALTY} goodwill with the Empire when {JUSTICIAR_pronoun} returns. {JUSTICIAR_nameDef} waits {TIME} for your answer; silence counts as a refusal.
LanguageData.MJV_CommandHoldSermonDesc: Choose the colonists who will hear {JUSTICIAR_nameDef}'s sermon. {JUSTICIAR_nameDef} waits {TIME} more for your answer.
LanguageData.MJV_CommandRefuseSermonDesc: Refuse {JUSTICIAR_nameDef}'s sermon. {JUSTICIAR_nameDef} will take offense, and it will cost you {PENALTY} goodwill with the Empire when {JUSTICIAR_pronoun} returns.
LanguageData.MJV_ConfirmRefuseSermon: Refuse {JUSTICIAR_nameDef}'s sermon?\n\n{JUSTICIAR_nameDef} will take offense, and it will cost you {PENALTY} goodwill with the Empire when {JUSTICIAR_pronoun} returns.
LanguageData.MJV_SermonRefused: The colony refused {JUSTICIAR_nameDef}'s sermon. The Empire will hear of it when {JUSTICIAR_pronoun} returns (-{PENALTY} goodwill).
LanguageData.MJV_SermonRequestIgnored: {JUSTICIAR_nameDef} waited in vain for the colony to assemble, and takes the silence as a refusal (-{PENALTY} goodwill when {JUSTICIAR_pronoun} returns).
LanguageData.MJV_SermonRequestLapsed: {JUSTICIAR_nameDef}'s request for a sermon has lapsed: the colony was in no state to hold it.
LanguageData.MJV_SermonDanger: Not while the colony is in danger.
LanguageData.MJV_SermonOtherGathering: Another gathering or ritual is under way.
LanguageData.MJV_SermonNobodyToListen: None of your colonists can attend.
LanguageData.MJV_AlertSermonRequestedDesc: A justiciar is waiting for your colony to assemble for a sermon. Select the justiciar to hold the sermon or refuse it; a request left unanswered counts as a refusal.\n\n{0}
LanguageData.MJV_SermonDialogDesc: {JUSTICIAR_nameDef} will preach {FAITH} to your colonists. At least {REQUIRED} of your {ELIGIBLE} conscious colonists must attend. Those who attend cannot be drafted while the colony is safe, and every listener whose certainty breaks converts to the imperial faith.
LanguageData.MJV_SermonDialogRules: Every colonist beyond the minimum pleases {JUSTICIAR_nameDef}: a sermon the whole colony hears earns {BONUS} goodwill with the Empire when {JUSTICIAR_pronoun} returns. Cancelling the sermon, or sending listeners away until fewer than the minimum remain, counts as a refusal: -{PENALTY} goodwill when {JUSTICIAR_pronoun} returns.
LanguageData.MJV_SermonNeedsCongregation: At least {0} of {1} conscious colonists must attend ({2} chosen).
LanguageData.MJV_SermonCongregationTip: The justiciar asks for at least {0} of your {1} conscious colonists. Everyone beyond that pleases him: his satisfaction is the share of the colony beyond the minimum that attends, and the sermon earns that share of the full goodwill bonus when he returns to the Empire.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionaryArrivedSolo: {PREACHER_nameFull}, a justiciar of {FAITH}, has come from {FACTION_name} on a mission to bring the imperial faith to your colony.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionaryArrivedEscorted: {PREACHER_nameFull}, a justiciar of {FAITH}, has come from {FACTION_name} on a mission to bring the imperial faith to your colony. {PREACHER_nameDef} travels with {COUNT} {ESCORT}.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionaryAsksAudience: {PREACHER_nameDef} asks to speak with your colony before staying. Send a colonist to talk to {PREACHER_objective}: select the colonist and right-click {PREACHER_nameDef}. {PREACHER_nameDef} will explain what hosting {PREACHER_objective} would bring, and you can host {PREACHER_objective} or send {PREACHER_objective} away.\n\nIf you send {PREACHER_objective} away, or nobody talks to {PREACHER_objective} within {TIME}, {PREACHER_nameDef} will go home and {FACTION_name} will take offense (-{PENALTY} goodwill).
LanguageData.MJV_MissionaryHosted: {PREACHER_nameDef} will stay with your colony for {DURATION}.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionaryTurnedAway: {PREACHER_nameDef} has been sent away and is going home. {FACTION} takes offense (-{PENALTY} goodwill).
LanguageData.MJV_MissionaryGaveUp: Nobody came to talk to {PREACHER_nameDef}, who is going home. {FACTION} takes offense (-{PENALTY} goodwill).
LanguageData.MJV_MissionaryLeaving: {PREACHER_nameDef} has finished {PREACHER_possessive} mission and is leaving.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionaryLeavingConverted: Your whole colony now follows {FAITH}. {PREACHER_nameDef} considers {PREACHER_possessive} work here done and is leaving.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionEscortLeaving: Without their justiciar, the escort from {0} is going home.
LanguageData.MJV_LordReportAwaitingAudience: Waiting for someone from the colony to talk to.
LanguageData.MJV_AudienceText:
{PREACHER_nameFull} greets {SPEAKER_nameDef}:

"I am a justiciar of {FAITH}, sent by {FACTION_name} to bring the faith to your people. I ask to stay near your colony for {DURATION}."

If you host {PREACHER_objective}:
 - Now and then {PREACHER_nameDef} will ask you to gather at least {FRACTION} of your conscious colonists for a sermon. Sermons can convert those who do not share the imperial faith.
 - Every convert: +{GOODWILL} goodwill with {FACTION_name}.
 - Every sermon heard by more colonists than {PREACHER_nameDef} asked for: up to +{BONUS} goodwill when {PREACHER_pronoun} returns, +{MAXBONUS} at most over {PREACHER_possessive} stay.
 - Hold all of {PREACHER_possessive} sermons and keep {PREACHER_objective} content, and {PREACHER_nameDef} will leave you an imperial codex-auspex.
 - Every sermon you refuse or cancel: -{PENALTY} goodwill when {PREACHER_pronoun} returns.

If you send {PREACHER_objective} away, {FACTION_name} will take offense: -{DECLINE} goodwill.
LanguageData.MJV_AudienceLater: Let me think about it ({TIME} left)
LanguageData.MJV_AlertJusticiarAwaitsAudienceDesc: A visiting justiciar is waiting for someone from your colony to talk to. Select a colonist and right-click the justiciar to talk: you can host the justiciar or send them away. If nobody comes in time, the justiciar goes home and the Empire takes offense.\n\n{0}
LanguageData.MJV_MissionSettledText:
{JUSTICIAR_nameDef} has returned to {FACTION_name} and reported on {JUSTICIAR_possessive} mission.

Sermons held: {HELD}. For the congregations beyond {JUSTICIAR_possessive} minimum: {BONUS} goodwill.
Sermons refused or cancelled: {REFUSED}. {PENALTY} goodwill.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionSettledCodex: Pleased with your colony's hospitality, {JUSTICIAR_nameDef} has left you an imperial codex-auspex. It is on its way by drop pod.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionSettledNoCodex: {JUSTICIAR_nameDef} was not content enough with {JUSTICIAR_possessive} stay to leave a gift: a justiciar who heard no refusal and whose mood stayed above {1} on average leaves an imperial codex-auspex.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionColonyConvertedText: Your whole colony now follows {FAITH}. {PREACHER_nameDef} considers {PREACHER_possessive} work here done: the imperial shuttle has been called to collect {PREACHER_objective} early.
LanguageData.MJV_CalledToServiceText: {PAWN_nameDef} has heard the call of {FAITH} and has decided to leave with {PREACHER_nameDef} to serve the Empire.\n\n{PAWN_nameDef} is walking to the imperial shuttle to board it. If you want to keep {PAWN_objective}, you can arrest {PAWN_objective} before {PAWN_pronoun} gets there.
LanguageData.MJV_CalledToServiceLeftText: {PAWN_nameDef} has left with {PREACHER_nameDef} on the imperial shuttle to serve the Empire.
